Credfeto.ChangeLog.Cmd 1.10.216.2907-pull-405-merge
Usage: changelog [options]

Options:
  -f, --changelog <value>            The changelog filename to use
  -v, --version <value>              The version to extract
  -x, --extract <value>              The filename to write the extracted
  -r, --remove <value>               The entry type to remove
  -a, --add <value>                  The entry type to add
  -m, --message <value>              The message to add
  -t, --check-insert <value>         The branch to check the changelog again
  -c, --create-release <value>       The release version to create
  -p, --Pending                      If the release is pending
  -u, --un-released                  Prints the unreleased section to the console.
  -l, --lint                         Lint the changelog for correctness
      --additional-sections <value>  Additional change type sections allowed in unreleased (comma separated)
      --fix                          When used with --lint, rewrite the file to fix formatting issues
      --self-test                    Verify the tool's dependencies load, without touching any file, then exit
      --help                         Display this help
